selected_candidate.name: intraday_unchanged_close_range_absorption_share_238p
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: When a larger share of completed-session intrabar high-low exploration resolves back to an exactly unchanged adjacent closing level, transient auction pressure may have been absorbed rather than carried into a durable close update; that liquidity resilience may support performance from the next open through the third close.
selected_candidate.source_grid: Require the immutable raw 241-row stock-day identity, select exactly 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00, exclude standalone 09:30, form 119 adjacent close transitions independently inside each half, and preserve all 238 destination bars.
selected_candidate.destination_range_formula: For each allowed destination bar j, set h_j=log(high_j/low_j), retaining exact zero ranges.
selected_candidate.unchanged_close_rule: Set z_j=1 only when the raw float64 destination close equals the immediately preceding selected close exactly inside the same half; otherwise z_j=0. Do not round, use a tick tolerance, compare logs, or bridge lunch.
selected_candidate.factor_formula: Let Z=sum_j(h_j*z_j) and H=sum_j(h_j) over the fixed 238 within-half destinations. Return Z/H.
selected_candidate.support_rule: Require all 240 selected high, low, and close values finite and strictly positive with low<=close<=high; require every h_j finite and nonnegative and total destination range H finite and strictly positive. Exact zero ranges and exact unchanged closes remain in fixed support. There is no positive-range-count, nonzero-return-count, adjacent-informative-pair, activity, peer, prior-day, event-history, or subwindow minimum.
selected_candidate.availability: Known only after the signal-session 15:00 bar; no later session, daily return, quarterly value, Candidate49 observation, or provider request enters the factor.
